shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,280p' app/product/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort && find node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference -type f | sort | sed -n '1,260p' && sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md && sed -n '1,340p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md && sed -n '1,340p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' lib/data.ts && sed -n '1,260p' next.config.ts && sed -n '1,260p' tsconfig.json && git status --short && wc -l node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/instant.md"

/bin/bash -lc "ps -ef | rg '[n]ext (build|dev|start)' || true && find .next -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*lock*' -o -name 'lock' 2>/dev/null | sort && git diff -- app/product/page.tsx package.json next.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "stat .next/lock 2>/dev/null || true && ps -ef | rg '[n]ode|[n]ext' | sed -n '1,120p' && npx tsc --noEmit"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json package.json next.config.ts && find .next/server/app -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,160p' && rg -n -o 'Premium Widget|Loading inventory|in stock|Price:' .next/server/app .next/static 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,160p'"

/bin/bash -lc 'du -sh .next 2>/dev/null || true && file next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo 2>/dev/null || true && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json'
